trips.label: Lonavala

bus.via: Pune Ma Na Pa Bus Stop to Lonavala

trips.route_note: Frequent local and express trains run from Pune Junction to Lonavala in about an hour through the hill section; no changes needed.
trips.why: Trains take just 43 minutes, run frequently with no changes, and drop you right in the hill town.
know: Weekends get crowded, so go on a weekday if you can
Monsoon is the most scenic season but expect mist and slippery paths
Book return tickets early on weekends
